interpretation: Data and expected values for future protected tests. These are not candidate results, deployed test code or a login/auth fixture.

fieldContract.comparison: Compare three field values and exact allowlisted field membership. Localized labels, ordering and copy serialization are a DesignSpec choice, not a new user standard; freeze a verifier-owned decoder from that design before UI execution.
fieldContract.fallbackAuthority: Reuse the unchanged shared/application modules; the null fallbacks and carrier precedence below come from their pinned baseline bytes, not a new fallback requirement.

clipboard.readScope: Only a proven isolated fixture clipboard, never the operator host clipboard.
clipboard.success: Read clipboard from an independent device/broker observation after copy and compare to the frozen three-field design decoder. A toast or app callback is not proof.
clipboard.cleanup: Restore and observe the fixture-owned prior synthetic value.

installedCandidate.expectedValuesSource: Read the independently inspected candidate app/native receipt and pinned unchanged application environment mapping; never read expected version/build from the candidate diagnostics UI.

privacyLimit: Synthetic sentinels plus a three-field data boundary test provide deterministic negative coverage. They do not claim a general static information-flow proof or coverage of a real authenticated session.
missingForDeployment: Root/independent-verifier-owned immutable test implementation and fixtures.
A proven login-free route/page fixture using no real account and no change to auth gates.
An isolated device clipboard, foreground state, installed-build identity and actual maximum text-size observer.
